soundness_flags.label: ass:schedule-conditioning
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited Afsari paper studies joint-diagonalizer sensitivity through diagonalizer condition number and uniqueness modulus, not the stated bounded normalized schedule-entry condition; retag this as novel and justify it as an experimental design regularity condition.

soundness_flags.label: prop:exact-fiber-identity
soundness_flags.one_line: Both sides are defined by the identical all-order set builder, so the asserted equality is a pure definitional restatement rather than a substantive proposition.
